R1.name: identity
R1.description: Semantic ownership, canonical identity and duplicate meaning drift.

R2.name: boundary
R2.description: Layer, authorization, mutation or persistence boundary violations.

R3.name: state
R3.description: Source, generated authority, schema or context drift.

R4.name: runtime
R4.description: Environment, queue, scheduler, dependency and production lifecycle risk.

R5.name: delivery
R5.description: Git provenance, branch divergence, exact-SHA evidence and promotion risk.

R6.name: recovery_security
R6.description: Recovery failure, secret exposure, external-input and security risk.

G1.name: code_local
G1.intent: Formatting, static analysis, Unit/Architecture and local contracts.

G3.name: persistence_runtime
G3.intent: G2 plus PostgreSQL/runtime/Redis/migration evidence when selected by impact.

G4.name: promotion_release
G4.intent: Impact verification, candidate, canonical, exact-SHA and CI promotion evidence.

facade.status: Read-only Git, roadmap and delivery-kernel state summary.
facade.plan: Delegate planning to the existing repository impact resolver.
facade.check: Delegate focused verification to the existing impact verification owner.
facade.close: Existing canonical closure owner; no kernel reimplementation.
facade.promote: Read-only exact-tree readiness preflight; GitHub Ready-for-review plus CI remain promotion authority.

promotion_closure.trigger: pull request non-draft boundary; Ready-for-review starts closure and later non-draft synchronize invalidates/reruns it

github_auto_closure.role: Promotion-only PREPARE, full CHECK and CLOSE orchestration for same-repository non-draft pull requests.
github_auto_closure.human_gate: Move the bounded implementation PR to Ready for review to request G4 closure; after exact-head evidence passes, accept authored stage/tranche state and merge explicitly. Any later non-draft source commit invalidates and reruns closure.

github_mobile_control_plane.role: Tap-only manual fallback for constrained mobile operators.
